# fMRI_SpikeEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of converting continuous fMRI blood-oxygen-level-dependent signals into discrete spike trains suitable for SNN input. Critical for translating biological neural activity into spike-based representations that neuromorphic hardware can process in real time.
